kebab_example: aliyun pvtz add-resolver-rule --zone-name example.com --forward-ip Ip=172.16.XX.XX Port=8080 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddResolverRule

parameters.help_en: The name of the forwarding rule. Specify a name based on your business requirements and the purpose of the rule
parameters.help_zh: 转发规则名称，根据业务需要及业务含义进行规则命名
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the forwarding rule. Valid values:
OUTBOUND: forwards DNS queries to external IP addresses. This is the only supported value.
You cannot change this value after the forwarding rule is created
parameters.help_zh:
转发规则类型：OUTBOUND（目前仅支持选择转发至外部IP）。
创建转发规则之后，无法更改此值
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The domain name (zone) for which you want to forward DNS resolution requests.

You cannot change this value after the forwarding rule is created
parameters.help_zh:
需要转发解析请求的域名（Zone）。

创建转发规则之后，无法更改此值
parameters.name: zone_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the outbound endpoint. The outbound endpoint is used to forward DNS query traffic to the IP addresses specified in the destination IP address list
parameters.help_zh: 出站终端节点ID。使用该出站终端节点将DNS查询流量转发到目标IP地址列表中指定的IP地址
parameters.name: endpoint_id

fields.help_en:
The destination IP address.
IP addresses in the following CIDR blocks are reserved for the system and cannot be configured as IP addresses of the external DNS system: 100.100.2.136 to 100.100.2.138, and 100.100.2.116 to 100.100.2.118
fields.help_zh:
转发目标IP地址。
以下地址段内的IP地址为系统预留地址，不允许被配置为外部DNS系统的IP地址：100.100.2.136~100.100.2.138，100.100.2.116~100.100.2.118
fields.name: ip

fields.help_en: The port number of the destination IP address
fields.name: port

parameters.help_en:
The IP addresses and ports of the external DNS system. These are the IP addresses and ports of the destination servers to which DNS query traffic is forwarded. You can specify up to 6 IP addresses and ports. Both private IP addresses and public IP addresses are supported.
If the external DNS server you specify uses a public IP address and the ECS instances in the VPC of the outbound endpoint are not assigned public IP addresses, activate a NAT gateway and configure SNAT entries for the VPC NAT gateway
parameters.help_zh:
外部DNS系统IP地址和端口。DNS查询流量被转发的目标服务器的IP地址和端口，最多创建6个，支持私网IP地址和公网IP地址。
若您填写的外部DNS服务器为公网IP，且您出站终端节点VPC内ECS无公网IP，请开通NAT网关并配置创建和管理VPC NAT网关的SNAT条目
parameters.name: forward_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.

en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh：中文。

en：英文。

默认值：en
parameters.name: lang

RuleId.description_en: The ID of the forwarding rule
